Real garment photographs used as negatives in the size-chart detector tests (none of them may be classified
as a size chart or text graphic). Resized copies of images from the "clothing-dataset-small" by Alexey
Grigorev (https://github.com/alexeygrigorev/clothing-dataset-small), released under CC0 1.0. Files 00-06 are
photos an early version of the detector misclassified (garment as the dominant flat colour, stripes, prints).
